query: WITH intro AS (SELECT kind, job_id, recorded_at, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY business_id ORDER BY recorded_at, seq) AS nth FROM payments.ledger_entry WHERE kind IN ('charge', 'free-first-win', 'repeat-customer', 'fee-free-job-type')) SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE kind <> 'charge') AS "part!", count(*) AS "whole!" FROM intro WHERE nth > 1 AND job_id = ANY($1) AND recorded_at >= $2 AND recorded_at < $3
